reason: A DeepSeek Harness channel plugin that connects private Weixin chats to persistent Harness agents, supporting QR authorization, text and media messaging, session commands, and approval-gated tool execution.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入腾讯微信私聊，支持二维码授权、文本与媒体消息、持久会话及审批控制的工具调用。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to private Weixin chats with QR authorization, text and media messaging, persistent sessions, and approval-controlled tool calls.

capabilities: Connects to Weixin through Tencent's iLink/ClawBot protocol
Performs QR-based account authorization and stores the resulting credential through the Harness credential provider
Receives and sends text, voice-transcription, image, and file messages
Maintains persistent conversations and session state
Dispatches Harness agent turns and structured tool-approval requests
Downloads and decrypts inbound media and uploads encrypted outbound media
Can permit approved agent tool calls with workspace-write or escalated filesystem access
